name: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare - Launch Edition
storyline: In a future where Earth's natural resources have run dry, humanity depends on colonies scattered across the Solar System, and the Solar Associated Treaty Organization defends the home planet and its interests. That fragile peace shatters when the Settlement Defense Front, a militant faction born from breakaway Martian colonies, launches a devastating surprise attack determined to seize control of the entire Solar System. Amid the chaos, Lieutenant Nick Reyes, a Special Combat Air Recon pilot, suddenly finds himself the highest-ranking officer aboard the warship Retribution and is thrust into command. Piloting a versatile transforming fighter called the Jackal and supported by his wingman Nora Salter and a loyal combat robot named Ethan, Reyes must rally his outmatched crew against the SDF and its ruthless commander, Admiral Salen Kotch. From the streets of Geneva to the far reaches of space, Reyes leads a desperate fight to turn the tide of an interplanetary war.
summary: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare - Launch Edition includes Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare as well as the Terminal Bonus Map and Zombies in Spaceland Pack, contains a weapon camo, calling card, and a Fate and Fortune Card Pack!
